# PanePilot v0.7.0

PanePilot 0.7 streamlines project setup and remote folder navigation while tightening
session lifecycle behavior.

## Highlights

- Create a local or SSH project from an existing folder or make a new folder in the
  dialog. The unified SSH browser adds fuzzy filtering, inline folder creation, and
  Tab, arrow, slash, and Enter navigation; new LaTeX folders receive a minimal main
  document.
- Preview project Notes with the same sanitized GitHub-style renderer used by Files,
  copy exact provider session IDs from LLM Chats, and open the Git pane for repositories
  that are local-only and have no `origin` remote.
- Archive projects more safely: PanePilot first stops every exact live terminal and
  capability chat, and leaves the project active if any stop fails. This release also
  repairs legacy deletion cascades and routes the KeyTips gesture only to the focused
  terminal.

## Download

The attached DMG and ZIP support Apple silicon Macs running macOS 12 or newer.
`SHA256SUMS.txt` contains SHA-256 checksums for both downloads. PanePilot has no
automatic update channel; install new versions from this repository.

PanePilot Remote for Android remains available as source under `android/`; this
release does not include a signed Android APK.

Stable latest-release link: [github.com/Salazar-Prime/PanePilot/releases/latest](https://github.com/Salazar-Prime/PanePilot/releases/latest)

## First launch

This desktop build is ad-hoc signed and is not Apple-notarized. After copying
PanePilot to Applications, Control-click it in Finder, choose **Open**, and confirm
the launch. Do not disable Gatekeeper. Download PanePilot artifacts only from this
GitHub repository.
